pdf_page_count reads the page count of a PDF without rendering a page

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';
import 'package:xberg/src/xberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final result = await XbergBridge.pdfPageCount(File('pdf/sample_contract.pdf').readAsBytesSync());
    stdout.writeln(result);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
